tools.name: sumit_list_documents
tools.description: List accounting documents (invoices, receipts, credit notes, quotes, and more) in the SUMIT account, filtered by type, number, and date. Returns Documents and HasNextPage; page with start_index and page_size. SUMIT API: POST /accounting/documents/list/.

tools.name: sumit_get_document
tools.description: Get one document with its customer, items, payments, and totals. Give document_id, or document_type with document_number (the number printed in the title). SUMIT API: POST /accounting/documents/getdetails/.

tools.name: sumit_get_next_document_number
tools.description: Get the number SUMIT would give the next document of this type. It reserves nothing. SUMIT API: POST /accounting/general/getnextdocumentnumber/.

tools.name: sumit_get_customer_debt
tools.description: Get how much one customer owes, by comparing the debit types (documents that raise debt) with the credit types (documents that settle it). SUMIT API: POST /accounting/documents/getdebt/.

tools.name: sumit_get_debt_report
tools.description: Get the debt of every customer who owes money, using the same debit and credit types as sumit_get_customer_debt. SUMIT API: POST /accounting/documents/getdebtreport/.

tools.name: sumit_list_income_items
tools.description: List the income items (products and services) in the SUMIT catalog, with price, cost, SKU, and external identifier. SUMIT marks this API alpha, so its shape may change. SUMIT API: POST /accounting/incomeitems/list/.

tools.name: sumit_list_stock_levels
tools.description: List the stock level of catalog items. Leave item_ids empty for all items. SUMIT API: POST /stock/stock/list/.

tools.name: sumit_get_vat_rate
tools.description: Get the VAT rate (Rate, in percent) that applies on a date. Leave date empty for today. SUMIT API: POST /accounting/general/getvatrate/.

tools.name: sumit_get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Get the exchange rate from one currency to another on a date (SUMIT defaults: USD to ILS, today). SUMIT API: POST /accounting/general/getexchangerate/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sumit_list_documents, sumit_get_document, sumit_get_next_document_number, sumit_get_customer_debt, sumit_get_debt_report, sumit_list_income_items, sumit_list_stock_levels, sumit_get_vat_rate, sumit_get_exchange_rate · Private data: sumit_list_documents, sumit_get_document, sumit_get_next_document_number, sumit_get_customer_debt, sumit_get_debt_report · Public sink: sumit_list_documents, sumit_get_document, sumit_get_next_document_number, sumit_get_customer_debt, sumit_get_debt_report, sumit_list_income_items, sumit_list_stock_levels, sumit_get_vat_rate, sumit_get_exchange_rate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sumit_list_documents, sumit_get_document, sumit_get_next_document_number, sumit_get_customer_debt, sumit_get_debt_report, sumit_list_income_items, sumit_list_stock_levels, sumit_get_vat_rate, sumit_get_exchange_rate · Private data: sumit_list_documents, sumit_get_document, sumit_get_next_document_number, sumit_get_customer_debt, sumit_get_debt_report · Public sink: sumit_list_documents, sumit_get_document, sumit_get_next_document_number, sumit_get_customer_debt, sumit_get_debt_report, sumit_list_income_items, sumit_list_stock_levels, sumit_get_vat_rate, sumit_get_exchange_rate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
